title: Ollie the Oil Truck and the Quiet Corner Leak
description: Ollie spots a tiny puddle on the night road, helps with a soft cleanup, and rests under the moon.

Ollie.role: Main character; a careful, kind neighborhood oil truck
Ollie.color: Round sunny-yellow tank body with navy blue trim and cream bumper accents
Ollie.bodyShape: Short rounded oil tanker with a soft oval tank, short hood, curved fenders, and no arms or hands
Ollie.face: Large soft hazel windshield eyes and a gentle smile in the front grille
Ollie.wheels: Four dark charcoal tires with navy hubcaps and tiny cream center dots
Ollie.accessories: Small navy side mirrors, a pale silver fill cap on the tank top, and a folded soft absorbent cloth roll tucked beside the rear bumper

Pippa.role: Supporting character; a tiny tidy sweep cart friend
Pippa.color: Soft mint-green body with cream brushes and navy wheel hubs
Pippa.bodyShape: Very small rounded sweep cart with two soft brushes and no arms or hands
Pippa.face: Round blue windshield eyes and a tiny friendly smile
Pippa.wheels: Four small charcoal tires with cream hubcaps

settingBible.Quiet Corner Lane: A calm vehicle neighborhood with brick workshops, flower boxes, a gentle bend in the road, warm street lanterns, and a low stone curb
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle evening colors, and no readable text

continuityRules: Ollie keeps the same sunny-yellow tank, navy trim, cream bumper accents, soft hazel windshield eyes, and four matching wheels on every page.
Ollie and every vehicle have no human-like arms or hands.
Pippa remains a tiny mint-green sweep cart with cream brushes and blue windshield eyes.
The tiny oil puddle appears on Page 4 and shrinks through the soft cleanup until it is gone by Page 12.
The absorbent cloth roll appears with Ollie from Page 1 and is used during cleanup on Pages 8-11.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, soft twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: One calm evening, Ollie the Oil Truck rolled along Quiet Corner Lane. His sunny-yellow tank shone softly.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie rolls along a brick-lined workshop street at golden evening with flower boxes and warm lanterns behind him.
pages.continuityNotes: Establish Ollie's sunny-yellow tank, navy trim, cream bumper, soft hazel windshield eyes, four matching wheels, navy mirrors, silver fill cap, and cloth roll.

pages.text: He hummed a quiet song for the sleepy workshops. Tiny moths danced around the lanterns.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie pauses near glowing workshop windows while moths circle warm lanterns above the quiet lane.
pages.continuityNotes: Keep Ollie's exact colors and features. Setting shows Quiet Corner Lane workshops and lanterns.

pages.text: Around the quiet bend, Ollie slowed. Something shiny waited by the curb.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie approaches a gentle road bend with a low stone curb while a faint shine appears near the pavement edge.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce the bend and curb geography used later. Ollie remains consistent; puddle not fully shown yet.

pages.text: Oh! A tiny oil puddle sat on the night road. It was small, but it made the corner slippery.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie stops safely before a small dark shiny puddle on the pavement near the stone curb under lavender dusk light.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce the tiny puddle clearly. Keep it small and non-scary. Ollie has no arms.

pages.text: Ollie blinked carefully. “I need to keep this corner safe for my friends.”
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie looks toward the tiny puddle with a caring expression while the empty quiet lane curves ahead.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem continues. Cloth roll still tucked beside the rear bumper and unused.

pages.text: Just then, Pippa the tiny sweep cart rolled up. “I can help too,” she chirped.
pages.illustrationScene: Little mint-green Pippa rolls beside Ollie's front wheel near the puddle, looking ready and kind.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Pippa's mint-green body, cream brushes, blue eyes, and four small wheels. Scale: Pippa is much smaller than Ollie.

pages.text: Together they planned a gentle cleanup. Ollie would soak. Pippa would sweep soft and slow.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie and Pippa face the tiny puddle side by side on the quiet corner, lantern light reflecting on the shine.
pages.continuityNotes: Teamwork begins. Puddle still present and small. No arms on either vehicle.

pages.text: Ollie nudged his soft cloth roll onto the puddle. The cloth drank the shiny drops.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie carefully presses his absorbent cloth roll against the tiny puddle using his bumper only, with Pippa watching nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Show cloth-roll contact via bumper/body only—no arms or hands. Puddle begins to shrink.

pages.text: Pippa swept the dry edge with her cream brushes. “Almost gone,” she said.
pages.illustrationScene: Pippa gently brushes the dry pavement edge around the shrinking puddle while Ollie holds the cloth roll in place with his bumper.
pages.continuityNotes: Puddle smaller than Page 8. Keep both character designs locked.

pages.text: Ollie checked again and found one last shiny spot. He pressed the cloth once more.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie presses the cloth on a final tiny shiny spot near the curb while Pippa waits with brushes lifted.
pages.continuityNotes: Nearly resolved. Cloth roll visibly damp; corner mostly clean.

pages.text: The corner looked smooth and safe. No more slippery shine waited on the road.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie and Pippa admire the clean dry pavement at Quiet Corner Lane under clearing twilight lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Puddle is gone. Road is dry and safe. Same bend and curb geography.

pages.text: Ollie rolled the cloth back to his bumper pocket. Pippa gave a tiny happy beep.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie tucks the used cloth roll beside his rear bumper while Pippa beeps happily on the clean corner.
pages.continuityNotes: Cleanup tools put away. No puddle remains. Characters unchanged.

pages.text: Friends rolled past with soft thank-yous. The quiet corner felt ready for night.
pages.illustrationScene: Two small friendly cars roll carefully past Ollie and Pippa on the clean corner, offering grateful glances.
pages.continuityNotes: Supporting cars are simple rounded shapes with no arms. Moon begins to rise.

pages.text: Ollie and Pippa parked side by side beneath the lanterns. The lane grew still and calm.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie and Pippa rest together near the workshop lanterns as the street grows quiet under early moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Transition to bedtime. Same locked designs. Clean corner visible behind them.

pages.text: That night, Ollie rested under the quiet moon. Goodnight, Ollie. Goodnight, Pippa.
pages.illustrationScene: Ollie rests on Quiet Corner Lane beneath a crescent moon while Pippa sleeps nearby and the clean curb gleams softly.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm bedtime ending. Ollie keeps all locked features. No puddle. Peaceful night scene.
